mapper.select: select count(*) from spas_student s left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0'
select count(*) from spas_warning_record r join spas_student s on s.student_id = r.student_id left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id where r.status = '0'
select count(*) from spas_paper p left join sys_dept d on p.dept_id = d.dept_id where p.status = '1'

select k.knowledge_id as "knowledgeId", k.subject_id as "subjectId", k.knowledge_name as name, avg(sks.weighted_rate) as rate, count(distinct sks.student_id) as "studentCount" from spas_student_knowledge_stat sks join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = sks.knowledge_id join spas_student s on s.student_id = sks.student_id left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id where sks.weak_level in ('1', '2', '3')
group by k.knowledge_id, k.subject_id, k.knowledge_name, k.order_num order by avg(sks.weighted_rate) asc, k.order_num asc limit #{limit}
